fact: Cenfri reports that NISR staff built a machine-learning model that predicts ISIC, ISCO and ISCED codes from Kinyarwanda, English or French descriptions, and that it is now used by analysts and monitors, with 96 percent of records auto-coded correctly in one test run.
UNDP says it deployed country-hosted AI compute capacity in Rwanda under its AI Infrastructure Activation programme.
UNDP's programme procured and deployed country-hosted GPU compute in Rwanda.

BMZ Digital.Global says a satellite and AI crop mapping method was developed by the Rwanda Space Agency, the Ministry of Agriculture, Alliance Bioversity-CIAT and FAIR Forward, is freely accessible and documented, and is being tested in four districts.
